# Alcohol and Tobacco tax collections (in thousands) from the bulletins
# FY1952 to FY1961

# Data from bulletins:
# FY1952-1959: 1960_08_page_77

alcohol = {
    1952: 2549120,
    1953: 2780925,
    1954: 2797718,
    1955: 2742840,
    1956: 2920574,
    1957: 2973195,
    1958: 2946461,
    1959: 3002096,
    1960: 3193714,
    1961: 3212801
}

tobacco = {
    1952: 1565162,
    1953: 1654911,
    1954: 1580512,
    1955: 1571213,
    1956: 1613497,
    1957: 1674050,
    1958: 1734021,
    1959: 1806816,
    1960: 1931504,
    1961: 1991117
}

# Calculate totals
total_alcohol = sum(alcohol.values())
total_tobacco = sum(tobacco.values())

print(f"Total Alcohol Taxes (1952-1961): {total_alcohol:,}")
print(f"Total Tobacco Taxes (1952-1961): {total_tobacco:,}")

# Percentage difference: (Alcohol - Tobacco) / Tobacco * 100
# This is "percentage difference in A compared to B"
pct_diff = ((total_alcohol - total_tobacco) / total_tobacco) * 100

print(f"\nPercentage difference (Alcohol vs Tobacco): {pct_diff:.2f}%")

# Also try symmetric formula just to check
# |A-B| / ((A+B)/2) * 100
symmetric = (abs(total_alcohol - total_tobacco) / ((total_alcohol + total_tobacco)/2)) * 100
print(f"Symmetric percentage difference: {symmetric:.2f}%")
